sloka: सुमित्रया तु सहिता कौसल्या पतितम् पतिम् ।उत्थापयाम् आस तदा वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५७-२८॥
transliteration: sumitrayā tu sahitā kausalyā patitam patim ।utthāpayām āsa tadā vacanam ca idam abravīt ॥2-57-28॥

translations.english: Having seen her husband collapsed on the ground, Kausalya assisted by Sumitra lifted him up and said to him thus:
